problem: Pension Credit verified receipt among potentially entitled pension-age low-income households

sourceContext.source: MHCLG English Indices of Deprivation 2025 statistical release, Table 8
MHCLG English Indices of Deprivation 2025 statistical release, Table 7
DWP Income-related benefits estimates of take-up FYE 2025

criteria.deskEvidence: Official older-age income deprivation 46.7% ranks Newham third among local authorities; geographically and age-specific need is supported, but benefit eligibility is unmeasured.
criteria.gate: Do not use income deprivation as eligibility denominator.

criteria.deskEvidence: F0-02 annotated benefit-take-up reviews are heterogeneous; no demonstrated Newham-specific incremental effect or independent meta-analytic answer.
criteria.gate: Review sources and policy transferability independently.

criteria.deskEvidence: Existing Newham council service and public context can be described; DWP local model table row, claimant records, controller, approved comparator, costs and partner capacity not established.
criteria.gate: Require lawful local data and accountable delivery partner before any field activity.

criteria.deskEvidence: Potential risk of older people's stigma, benefit misinformation, inaccessible outreach, inappropriate data use and diversion of existing local services.
criteria.gate: Independent ethics/safeguarding and community review, non-digital access and no benefit withholding.

criteria.deskEvidence: Our Newham Money already reported 220 assisted claims and £748,590 attributed additional income in 2024/25; HPI incremental value over this pre-existing work remains unknown.
criteria.gate: Demonstrate novel research value; otherwise no outreach/no-go.

criteria.deskEvidence: A participant-level confirmed receipt denominator could be designed conceptually, but approved local numerator, denominator, follow-up, uncertainty and equity data are missing.
criteria.gate: Prespecify and independently approve verified receipt endpoint and missingness before study.

fieldGates.why: No legally accountable institution or sponsor
No local verified eligible denominator and confirmed benefit receipt record access
No independent pre-specified causal/statistical design sign-off
No ethics committee, safeguarding, consent and lawful basis package
No ethically conducted affected-community and accessibility participation
No Newham/DWP/qualified implementation partner or approved additionality
No verified 12–24 month delivery budget or funded research capacity

sourceAuthority: HPI F0-02.5 #7, F0-03.1 #19 and F0-05 #11 remain open
